summary: Hikvision Europe BV. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: The European arm of Chinese security-camera maker Hikvision, based in Hoofddorp, with a few English-language internships and an IND sponsor licence.

culture.text: Its current openings are all internships in Hoofddorp, spread across sales, IT/security and operations.

open.text: Hikvision Europe B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor, so it can hire non-EU staff on a work visa.
All 3 of its current openings here are open to people who don't speak Dutch.

worth_knowing.text: It is the European branch of a Chinese maker of video cameras and security equipment, with its European base in the Netherlands.
